verdict.rationale: Fenwick & West is a law firm selling legal services, so an interactive API reference with runnable examples is a category error for this kind of product. Its client-facing tools (trademark extranet, AI review tools, Fenwick Labs) are not described as exposing a developer API. The 404 probes for OpenAPI paths and llms.txt are consistent with no public API surface.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
